question: Does disrupting an annotated nearby tiny neighbor, without touching any target pixels, improve a fixed target's pre-NMS evidence beyond an equal-size, equal-distance background disruption?
route: New input-to-representation diagnostic, not fusion, calibration, NMS, box replacement, or a continuation of candidate66.
selection: Hash all existing output/analysis/*/plan.json files and exclude exact image stems found in their text. Use detector-training data only. Sort sequence prefixes by SHA256('candidate67-sequence-v1:'+prefix). Within each sequence sort remaining images by SHA256('candidate67-image-v1:'+stem); choose the first with at least two eligible target-neighbor-sham tuples, using metadata geometry only. Take the first96 qualifying sequences; first48screen,last48confirmation. At most4 target tuples/image in SHA256('candidate67-target-v1:'+stem+':'+GT_index) order. No prediction/response-based population filtering.
geometry: Target and neighbor both have original-pixel integer floor/ceil rectangles at least4x4 and GT area*(640/max(image_size))^2<256. Neighbor center distance<=4*sqrt(target_GT_area). The neighbor rectangle must not intersect any other valid-object or ignore box expanded by2original pixels; this protects target+margin. Choose the closest eligible neighbor by squared center distance, then GT_index. Sham is the same integer width/height rectangle reflected in target center across x,y,or both, rounded by np.rint. It must fit image, not intersect ANY GT/ignore box expanded by2px, and its center-distance discrepancy is<=1px. Among eligible shams choose the lowest per-channel mean/std squared texture discrepancy to the neighbor, divided by255^2 (tie reflection order). Geometry eligibility requires a sham, but image choice does not use texture or responses.
reference: Frozen verified960 checkpoint, square960 FP16 full-image view only. Existing predictor may compute NMS, but no post-NMS output is used in query choice, primary measurement or decision. No tiles, fusion or calibration.
queries: P3 stride8 3x3 lattice around nearest GT-center anchor in square960 letterbox coordinates, clipped to120x120. Select original row maximizing sigmoid(GT_class_logit)*IoU(original_decoded_box,target_GT), first-index ties. Keep that exact row and GT class for every intervention; no perturbed rematching or row/class reselection. Report fixed-query GT-conditioned diagnostic only.
perturbations: Mean: np.rint(per-channel patch mean) uint8. Blur: cv2.GaussianBlur(original patch,(0,0),sigmaX=max(1,min(width,height)/3),borderType=BORDER_REFLECT_101), pasted only inside original rectangle. Self_mean is a positive sensitivity control and changes target pixels intentionally. Mean/blur remove or weaken texture, not physical object presence or a natural absent-neighbor counterfactual.
integrity: Original full native decoded boxes/logits replay exactly on a repeated pristine forward/image. Nonself interventions preserve original source target rectangle and actual preprocessed960 target tensor rectangle bit-for-bit. Save fixed-query native boxes,10class logits,P3 neck features and penultimate classification features for all arms. Full detector parameter/buffer hashes before/after must match. Record initialized checkpoint and actual installed sources.
primary: Q=sigmoid(fixed_GT_class_logit)*IoU(fixed_row_box,target_GT), range[0,1]. For each fill report neighbor-minus-base and neighbor-minus-sham means; neither is AP/recall or a deployable gain. Also report logit changes,IoU changes,feature relativeL2,score>=.25+correctargmax+IoU>=.5 changes, and same/different neighbor-class subgroups without decision-rule selection.
uncertainty: Separate screen/confirmation, one image per distinct sequence. 2000 paired cluster bootstrap draws default_rng67, resample all48images with replacement and pool all query numerators/denominators. Empty images remain in population (geometry ensures>=2tuples). Thresholds fixed before detector inference; no alternate subgroup can rescue failure.
pass: REPLICATED_NONOVERLAPPING_NEIGHBOR_INTERFERENCE_SUPPORTS_SEPARATE_SMALL_REPRESENTATION_TRAINING_PILOT. This is only hypothesis support, not a deployable training recipe, AP improvement, novelty or full-training authorization.
fail: STOP_THIS_NONOVERLAPPING_NEIGHBOR_TEXTURE_INTERFERENCE_HYPOTHESIS_ON_FIXED_SCREEN. Do not alter fills, distance, overlap restrictions, queries, samples, classes or gates after outcomes to rescue this experiment.
budget: 96JPEG decodes;192original/replay forwards plus at most1920perturbed forwards;one explicit FrozenViews initialization prediction (internal backend warmup not separately counted);zero fits,gradients,optimizer steps,AP evaluations or weight updates. Data-selection reads and audit reruns counted separately. If fewer96qualifying sequences, stop feasibility without relaxing population.
limits: GT-based intervention/query construction;box labels not segmentation;blur/fill artifacts;sham matches size and distance but not all scene content;no guarantee neighbor is visually removed;no claim of real-image causal identification;detector has trained on these images;sequence halves are not external validation;negative result excludes this bounded recipe only.
prior_boundary: Repulsion Loss(CVPR2018) already addresses neighboring-instance localization drift and OR-CNN(ECCV2018) already uses occlusion-aware features and compact localization. D-RISE(CVPR2021) already uses masking to explain detections/context. Nonoverlapping neighbor versus protected-target matched background perturbation is a diagnostic question, not in itself a new method or priority claim.
